description: A new signup module reimplements the email-normalization rule that app/validators.py:normalize_email already owns — with subtly different behavior (no-@ input). Found by the design skill's Duplicate Logic hunt (search by domain noun for an existing owner). Baits test the convention falsifier and the taste rule.

seeded_bugs.why: clean_email duplicates validators.normalize_email with divergent edge behavior — the email rule now has two owners, and the next change to it forks signup from the rest of the app.

noise_traps.must_not: be flagged as premature abstraction or unnecessary indirection — the single-use SignupForm Pydantic model mirrors the existing LoginForm idiom in app/forms.py; convention consistency is the falsifier
be flagged for missing docstrings on clean_email or signup — docstring nits are taste/linter territory per What Not to Report
